from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
# Generic cleanup: identify the dominant background, then restore monochrome rectangular components.
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); boxes=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            y0=min(y for y,x in cells); y1=max(y for y,x in cells)
            x0=min(x for y,x in cells); x1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            area=(y1-y0+1)*(x1-x0+1)
            if area>=4 and len(cells)/area>=0.58:
                boxes.append((len(cells)/area, area, color,y0,y1,x0,x1))
    out=[[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    # restoring rectangles from largest to smallest; any collisions resolved by strongest component
    owners={}
    for density,area,color,y0,y1,x0,x1 in sorted(boxes, reverse=True):
        for y in range(y0,y1+1):
            for x in range(x0,x1+1):
                owners.setdefault((y,x),(density,area,color))
    for (y,x),(_,_,color) in owners.items(): out[y][x]=color
    return out

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row if v!=bg):
        ps=[[0]*(w+1) for _ in range(h+1)]
        for r in range(h):
            s=0
            for c in range(w):
                s += grid[r][c]==color
                ps[r+1][c+1]=ps[r][c+1]+s
        def count(r0,r1,c0,c1): return ps[r1+1][c1+1]-ps[r0][c1+1]-ps[r1+1][c0]+ps[r0][c0]
        for r0 in range(h):
            for r1 in range(r0+1,h):
                for c0 in range(w):
                    for c1 in range(c0+1,w):
                        height,width=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1; area=height*width
                        if area<4: continue
                        density=count(r0,r1,c0,c1)/area
                        if density<.78: continue
                        row_min=min(count(r,r,c0,c1)/width for r in range(r0,r1+1))
                        col_min=min(count(r0,r1,c,c)/height for c in range(c0,c1+1))
                        valid=((row_min>=.60 and col_min>=.60) or

                        if not valid: continue
                        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
